overview: About 280 early Eocene teeth, jaws and ankle bones expand the material used to interpret Dormaalocyon, replacing the older picture of “Miacis” latouri based on only two teeth. The larger sample supports dental, ankle and matrix observations, but does not by itself establish crown Carnivora membership or direct ancestry.

ecology.diet: Dentition supports an inference of small-prey or insect eating; stomach contents are not preserved.
ecology.habitat: A warm woodland is inferred from the locality context, not directly recorded as the animal’s preferred habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Tarsal anatomy suggests climbing ability, but movement was not observed.
ecology.bodySize: The sample documents a small carnivoraform; it does not provide a precise body-mass estimate.
ecology.guild: A small, climbing-capable faunivore is an anatomical inference, not a directly observed ecological role.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿支持其取食小型猎物或昆虫的推断；没有保存胃内容物。
ecology.habitatZh: 根据地点背景推测当地曾有温暖林地，但不能据此断定这是该动物偏好的栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 跗骨形态提示其可能具有攀爬能力，但没有直接观察到运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 材料显示这是一种小型食肉形类，但没有给出精确体重估计。
ecology.guildZh: 把它描述为小型、可能善于攀爬的食虫或食肉动物，是基于解剖的推断，并非直接观察到的生态角色。

traits: The expanded sample supports a reconstructed permanent dentition.
Ankle bones include astragali and a calcaneum.
A sampled character matrix places it among basal carnivoraforms.
evidenceSummary: The fossils support observations of teeth, ankles and a sampled character matrix. They do not establish membership in crown Carnivora, direct ancestry or a global first carnivoramorphan.
overviewZh: 约 280 件早始新世牙齿、颌骨和踝骨材料扩展了对 Dormaalocyon 的认识，修正了过去仅凭两枚牙齿理解“Miacis” latouri 的图景。较大的样本支持牙齿、踝部和矩阵分析中的观察，但本身不能证明其属于冠群食肉目或是直系祖先。
traitsZh: 扩大的标本组合支持重建其恒齿列。
踝部材料包括距骨和跟骨。
一项取样的特征矩阵将其置于基础食肉形类中。
evidenceSummaryZh: 化石支持牙齿、踝部和取样特征矩阵中的观察，但不能证明其属于冠群食肉目、是直系祖先或为全球最早的食肉形类。

commonNameZh: 西藏化石豹亚科（原始归属）
overview: The original combined fossil–molecular analysis assigned three cranial fragments from the Zanda Basin to Panthera blytheae and placed it near snow leopards. Both the genus assignment and that relationship are revisable analytical results.

ecology.diet: Felid dentition supports a meat-eating diet, but the partial skull does not reveal prey choice.
ecology.habitat: The Zanda Basin's high-elevation environment is inferred from regional evidence, not directly measured from this skull.
ecology.locomotion: The cranial sample does not preserve how the animal moved.
ecology.bodySize: Body size was inferred from partial cranial material, not measured from a complete skeleton.
ecology.guild: The study inferred a large terrestrial carnivore from the teeth; prey and behaviour are not preserved.
ecology.dietZh: 猫科动物的齿列支持肉食性判断，但不完整的头骨无法揭示其猎物选择。
ecology.habitatZh: 根据区域证据推断 Zanda 盆地属于高海拔环境；这一点并非直接从该头骨测得。
ecology.locomotionZh: 颅骨样本没有保存其运动方式的信息。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 体型是根据部分头骨材料推断，而非依据完整骨架测量。
ecology.guildZh: 研究根据牙齿推断其为大型陆生食肉动物；化石没有保存猎物或行为信息。

traits: Adult partial cranium
Associated ramus and premaxilla fragments
Characters used in a combined total-evidence analysis
evidenceSummary: The study documents IVPP V18788.1–3 and its original magnetostratigraphic age model. The taxonomic assignment and proposed snow-leopard affinity remain revisable; one Zanda sample does not establish an Asian origin for all pantherines.

title.en: Three fragments and a 5.95–4.10 million-year envelope
title.zh: 三件碎片与 5.95–4.10 百万年的年代包络

text.en: The original study describes IVPP V18788.1 as an adult partial cranium, with IVPP V18788.2–3 adding associated jaw and premaxilla fragments from China's Zanda Basin. The 5.95–4.10 million-year envelope follows the study's original magnetostratigraphic framework; it is not a species-wide first or last appearance.
text.zh: 原研究将 IVPP V18788.1 描述为成年个体的局部颅骨，IVPP V18788.2–3 补充了相关下颌支和前颌骨碎片，材料来自中国札达盆地。5.95–4.10 百万年的年代包络遵循原研究的磁性地层框架，并非该物种的首现或末现。

title.en: A proposed snow-leopard affinity, not a settled ancestor
title.zh: 提出的雪豹亲缘关系，不是已定论的祖先

text.en: The combined analysis assigned the fragments to Panthera and recovered an affinity with snow leopards. These are analytical placements, not facts visible in the fossil itself. Felid teeth support carnivory, but this cranial sample does not identify prey, movement or habitual habitat, and one Tibetan locality cannot establish the geographic origin of all pantherines.
text.zh: 综合分析将这些碎片归入 Panthera，并恢复出与雪豹的亲缘关系。这些是分析位置，不能直接从化石本身看出。猫科牙齿支持肉食性，但这组颅骨材料不能确定猎物、运动方式或惯常栖地；西藏一个地点也不能确定整个豹亚科的地理起源。

title.en: Tseng et al. (2014), Zanda Basin pantherine fossils
title.zh: Tseng 等（2014），札达盆地豹亚科化石

scope.en: IVPP V18788.1–3, the Zanda Basin locality, original magnetostratigraphic framework, Figures 1–4, Table S1 and Data S1–S3. The study supports its combined-analysis placement; it does not make the snow-leopard affinity or a pantherine origin in Asia uncontested.
scope.zh: IVPP V18788.1–3、札达盆地地点、原始磁性地层年代框架、图 1–4、表 S1 与数据 S1–S3。该研究支持综合分析中的位置，但不能使雪豹亲缘关系或豹亚科起源于亚洲成为无争议结论。

overviewZh: 综合分析将札达盆地三件头骨碎片归入 Panthera blytheae，并提出其与雪豹近缘；分类位置仍可修订。
evidenceSummaryZh: IVPP V18788.1–3 沿用原研究的磁性地层年代框架；单一地点样本不能判定豹亚科起源于亚洲。
traitsZh: 原研究将 IVPP V18788.1 描述为成年个体的局部颅骨。
IVPP V18788.2–3 补充了相关下颌支和前颌骨碎片。
具名材料的性状用于化石与分子综合证据分析；分类位置仍取决于分析。

overview: Holotype NUFV 405 preserves about 65% of one skeleton. Its weight-bearing limbs occur with traits used to infer freshwater swimming, a combination relevant to hypotheses about pinnipedimorph transitions but not proof of a direct ancestor.

ecology.diet: Dentition supports a carnivorous diet; prey are not directly preserved.
ecology.habitat: The fossil occurs in a freshwater-lake deposit. A habitual freshwater habitat is inferred rather than observed.
ecology.locomotion: Limb and body proportions support both terrestrial and semiaquatic capability as interpretations, not measured performance.
ecology.bodySize: The animal is described as medium musteloid-sized; the available account does not give a complete population range.
ecology.guild: A semiaquatic predatory role is inferred from anatomy and setting.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿支持肉食性推断；没有直接保存猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石出自淡水湖沉积层。长期利用淡水栖地是推断，并非直接观察。
ecology.locomotionZh: 肢体和身体比例支持其既能陆行、又可能半水生的解释，但运动表现没有经过测量。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 资料将其描述为中等鼬科动物大小；现有叙述没有给出完整的种群体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 依据解剖和沉积背景推测其为半水生捕食者。

traits: The holotype includes substantial cranial and postcranial material.
Its limbs could bear weight and also show proportions used to infer swimming.
A long tail and freshwater depositional context contribute to the semiaquatic interpretation.
evidenceSummary: The associated skeleton supports an anatomical mosaic. Semiaquatic locomotion, pinnipedimorph placement and a freshwater transition remain interpretations, not a direct-ancestor sequence or observed behavior.
overviewZh: 正模 NUFV 405 保存了约 65% 的一具骨架。可承重的四肢与用于推断淡水游泳能力的特征并存；这一组合与鳍足类演化过渡假说有关，但不能证明直系祖先关系。
traitsZh: 正模保存了较多颅后和头骨材料。
四肢可支撑身体，也具有被用于推断游泳能力的比例特征。
长尾及淡水湖沉积背景共同参与半水生生活方式的解释。
evidenceSummaryZh: 关节连接的骨架支持一种解剖镶嵌组合。半水生运动、鳍足类位置和淡水环境转变仍属解释，并非直系祖先序列或观察到的行为。

geography: North American Hesperocyoninae localities sampled by Wang
overview: Wang's monograph studies named Hesperocyon fossils within the extinct hesperocyonine canid radiation. A morphology matrix scores cranial and dental characters to test relationships among sampled species; it does not identify Hesperocyon as a direct ancestor of later canids.

ecology.diet: The systematic monograph does not directly establish diet.
ecology.habitat: The monograph's fossil localities do not establish a genus-wide habitat.
ecology.locomotion: The cited monograph does not establish postcranial locomotor performance.
ecology.bodySize: The sampled material is not used here to estimate a genus-wide body-size range.
ecology.guild: The cited systematic evidence does not assign a single ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 系统分类专著没有直接确定其食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 专著列出的化石地点不能确定该属整体的生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引专著没有确定其头后骨骼所反映的运动能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 此处未利用取样材料估算该属整体的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 所引系统学证据未指定单一生态类群。

traits: Named Hesperocyon specimens revised in a fossil canid monograph
Dental and cranial characters scored in a morphology matrix
Species-level relationships tested within sampled Hesperocyoninae
evidenceSummary: The 40–29 Ma display refers only to Hesperocyon material sampled in Wang's monograph and its North American localities. It is not a complete genus range, a global origination or extinction estimate, or a continuous-occupancy claim. The systematic sample does not directly establish ecology or direct ancestry.

title.en: Named fossils and a cranial–dental matrix
title.zh: 具名化石与头骨—牙齿矩阵

text.en: Wang's revision assembles named fossil material and scores cranial and dental characters to test species-level relationships within Hesperocyoninae, an extinct canid subfamily. The results describe the sampled fossils and analysis; they do not make Hesperocyon a demonstrated direct ancestor of later dogs.
text.zh: Wang 的修订汇集具名化石，并编码头骨和牙齿性状，检验已灭绝犬科亚科黄昏犬亚科内部的物种关系。结果描述所取样化石及分析，并未证明 Hesperocyon 是后期犬类的直系祖先。

title.en: The 40–29 Ma window has limited scope

text.en: The monograph's Hesperocyon sample comes from North American Hesperocyoninae localities. The 40–29 Ma display is a source-bounded window, not a global species duration, exact origin or extinction date, or claim of continuous presence. The cited systematic work does not directly establish diet, habitat, movement, body-size range or one ecological guild.
text.zh: 专著中的 Hesperocyon 样本来自北美黄昏犬亚科地点。40–29 Ma 是来源限定的窗口，不是全球物种延限、精确起源或灭绝年代，也不表示连续存在。所引系统研究没有直接确定食性、栖地、运动方式、体型范围或单一生态功能群。

title.en: Phylogenetic systematics of the Hesperocyoninae (Carnivora: Canidae)
title.zh: Phylogenetic systematics of the Hesperocyoninae (Carnivora: Canidae)

scope.zh: 读者段落的原始定位：supports; pages: 1–207; quoteLocator: Systematics of Hesperocyon; character matrix; phylogenetic analysis；supports; pages: 1–207; figure: Systematics figures and phylogenetic trees; quoteLocator: Systematics of Hesperocyon; character matrix; phylogenetic analysis；supports; pages: 1–207; quoteLocator: Introduction; geographic and stratigraphic distribution; Systematics of Hesperocyon；supports; pages: 1–207; quoteLocator: Systematics of Hesperocyon; character descriptions; character matrix；supports; pages: 1–207; quoteLocator: Study scope; systematics; character matrix; phylogenetic analysis

scope.zh: 读者段落的原始定位：contextualizes; pages: International Chronostratigraphic Chart v2026/06; figure: Global chronostratigraphic scale; quoteLocator: Numerical boundaries for named geological stages used to bound the source sample

overviewZh: Wang 的专著以头骨和牙齿矩阵检验灭绝黄昏犬亚科中 Hesperocyon 的种间关系；未将其认定为后期犬类的直系祖先。
evidenceSummaryZh: 40–29 Ma 仅对应专著所取样的北美 Hesperocyon 材料，不表示全球分布或连续的属级历史。
traitsZh: 专著修订了具名 Hesperocyon 化石材料；本页没有将这些标本合并为范围不明的属级样本。
形态矩阵对取样化石的头骨与牙齿性状进行编码。
分析检验取样黄昏犬亚科内部的物种关系，并未证明祖先序列。

geography: Pyramid Hill Sandstone Member, Jewett Sand
overview: The virtually complete Enaliarctos mealsi skeleton LACM 4321 anchors a study of early pinniped locomotor anatomy. Its vertebrae and limbs support comparisons of aquatic and terrestrial capability, not a direct-ancestor claim or a complete genus history.

ecology.diet: Not resolved by the cited skeletal locomotor study
ecology.habitat: Jewett Sand depositional setting; habitual ecology is not directly observed
ecology.locomotion: Aquatic and terrestrial locomotor capacities inferred comparatively from axial and limb anatomy
ecology.bodySize: Not projected as a genus-wide body-size estimate from one skeleton
ecology.guild: No feeding guild is assigned from the cited skeletal evidence
ecology.dietZh: 所引骨骼运动研究没有确定食性。
ecology.habitatZh: LACM 4321 出自 Jewett Sand 沉积环境；这一记录没有直接观察动物的惯常栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 轴骨和肢体解剖支持对水生及陆生运动能力的比较推断，并非运动表现测量。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 本页没有根据一具骨架推算全属体型。
ecology.guildZh: 所引骨骼证据没有指定取食功能群。

traits: Virtually complete LACM 4321 skeleton
Flexible lumbar vertebral morphology in the comparative interpretation
Flipper-like limbs with developed bony processes and muscle-attachment areas
evidenceSummary: LACM 4321 comes from the Pyramid Hill Sandstone Member of California's Jewett Sand and is dated to approximately 23 Ma. Swimming strokes, habitual habitat, diet and a universal pinniped history are not directly observed in this specimen.

title.en: One skeleton preserves spine and limbs together
title.zh: 一具骨架同时保存脊柱与四肢

text.en: LACM 4321 is a virtually complete skeleton of Enaliarctos mealsi. The study draws on lumbar vertebrae, flipper-like limbs and developed bony processes with muscle-attachment areas to compare locomotor anatomy. These are observations on one fossil, not measurements of every Enaliarctos species or a population-wide size range.
text.zh: LACM 4321 是一具近乎完整的 Enaliarctos mealsi 骨架。研究利用其腰椎、鳍状四肢，以及发达的骨突和肌肉附着区比较运动解剖。这些是对一件化石的观察，不是对所有 Enaliarctos 物种的测量，也不能给出种群体型范围。

title.en: Anatomy suggests capability, not observed behavior
title.zh: 解剖提示能力，不等于观察到行为

text.en: Comparisons of the spine and limbs are used to infer how this animal may have moved in water and on land. A skeletal model can test anatomical capability, but it does not preserve a swimming stroke, daily habitat or feeding event. The roughly 23 Ma occurrence is one central California record, not a route of pinniped dispersal.
text.zh: 研究通过比较脊柱与四肢，推断这只动物可能如何在水中和陆地上移动。骨骼模型可以检验解剖能力，却不会保存游泳动作、日常栖地或摄食事件。约 23 Ma 的产出记录来自加利福尼亚中部一处地点，不是鳍足类扩散路线。

overviewZh: 近乎完整的 Enaliarctos mealsi 骨架 LACM 4321 保存脊柱与四肢，是早期鳍足类运动解剖比较的核心样本。
evidenceSummaryZh: LACM 4321 出自 Jewett Sand 的 Pyramid Hill Sandstone Member，约 23 Ma；运动能力来自比较推断。
traitsZh: LACM 4321 保存了一具近乎完整的 Enaliarctos mealsi 骨架。
比较解释利用了灵活的腰椎形态。
四肢呈鳍状，并保存发达的骨突和肌肉附着区域。

overview: Holotype cranium UCMP 85202 is associated with skull, jaw and postcranial material from southern California, dated about 46.2–42 Ma. A broad morphology analysis leaves nearby carnivoramorphan relationships unresolved; a Paleogene-only subset places the genus among caniforms outside crown Canoidea.

ecology.diet: A six-variable discriminant model predicts carnivory for the holotype with 83% posterior probability; this is a model result, not observed feeding.
ecology.habitat: The specimens come from member C of the Santiago Formation; this depositional context does not establish habitual habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Postcranial elements are known, but the cited studies do not establish locomotor performance.
ecology.bodySize: A tooth-based regression estimates about 6 kg for the holotype; the estimate is not generalized across the genus.
ecology.guild: No broader ecological guild is assigned from a dietary classifier.
ecology.dietZh: 一个包含六个变量的判别模型以 83% 的后验概率预测正模为食肉性；这是模型结果，并非观察到的摄食行为。
ecology.habitatZh: 标本来自圣地亚哥组 C 段；这一沉积背景不能确定其惯常栖息环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 已知有后颅骨材料，但所引研究未能确定其运动能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 基于牙齿的回归估计正模体重约为 6 kg；这一估计未推广到整个属。
ecology.guildZh: 根据摄食分类器结果，没有为其指定更广泛的生态功能类群。

traits: The holotype UCMP 85202 preserves the cranium and dentition.
Associated SDSNH specimens add cranial, mandibular and selected postcranial bones.
The phylogenetic sample combines named cranial and postcranial material.
evidenceSummary: A six-variable discriminant model predicts carnivory for the holotype with 83% posterior probability, and a tooth-based regression estimates about 6 kg. Both are model outputs. The broader placement depends on the sampled morphology matrix; these results do not establish observed feeding, direct ancestry or a complete genus range.
overviewZh: 正模头骨 UCMP 85202 与南加州头骨、颌骨和颅后材料相关，年代约为 46.2–42 Ma。广泛形态分析未解决近缘食肉形类关系；仅含古近纪类群的子集将该属置于冠群犬总科之外的犬形类中。
evidenceSummaryZh: 六变量判别模型以 83% 的后验概率预测正模为食肉性，基于牙齿的回归估计其体重约为 6 kg；两者都是模型结果。较广的分类位置取决于取样形态矩阵，这些结果不能证明实际摄食、直系祖先关系或完整属级分布。

readerSources.title: A new basal caniform (Mammalia: Carnivora) from the middle Eocene of North America and remarks on the phylogeny of early carnivorans

scope.en: Tomiya (2011), pp. 2–3 and 13–16, Figures 2–8, Table 3 and Appendix S3: type and referred material, local horizon, matrix-based placements, and the 83% dietary classifier for the holotype.
scope.zh: Tomiya（2011），第 2–3、13–16 页，图 2–8、表 3 与附录 S3：正模及归入标本、局部层位、矩阵分析位置，以及正模的 83% 食性分类器结果。

title.en: UCMP 85202 and a bounded southern California sample
title.zh: UCMP 85202 与范围有限的南加州样本

text.en: Holotype cranium UCMP 85202 is associated with skull, jaw and postcranial material from southern California, dated about 46.2–42 Ma. A broad morphology analysis leaves nearby carnivoramorphan relationships unresolved; a Paleogene-only subset places the genus among caniforms outside crown Canoidea.
text.zh: 正模头骨 UCMP 85202 与南加州头骨、颌骨和颅后材料相关，年代约为 46.2–42 Ma。广泛形态分析未解决近缘食肉形类关系；仅含古近纪类群的子集将该属置于冠群犬总科之外的犬形类中。

title.en: A model and a matrix answer different questions
title.zh: 模型与矩阵回答不同问题

text.en: A six-variable discriminant model predicts carnivory for the holotype with 83% posterior probability, and a tooth-based regression estimates about 6 kg. Both are model outputs. The broader placement depends on the sampled morphology matrix; these results do not establish observed feeding, direct ancestry or a complete genus range.
text.zh: 六变量判别模型以 83% 的后验概率预测正模为食肉性，基于牙齿的回归估计其体重约为 6 kg；两者都是模型结果。较广的分类位置取决于取样形态矩阵，这些结果不能证明实际摄食、直系祖先关系或完整属级分布。

traitsZh: 正模 UCMP 85202 保存了头骨和齿列。
关联的 SDSNH 标本补充了颅骨、下颌和部分头后骨骼。
系统发育样本结合了具名的头骨和后颅骨材料。

overview: Kretzoiarctos beatrix is described from left fourth premolar MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42, right first molar NV-2-40 and partial mandible IPS 46473 from two Spanish middle Miocene localities. A fossil-and-living bear matrix places the genus within Ailuropodinae; that placement is an analytical result.

ecology.diet: Dental comparisons suggest a more herbivorous tendency; feeding was not observed
ecology.habitat: Spanish locality records only; habitual habitat is not directly observed
ecology.locomotion: Not resolved by the cited dental and mandibular material

title.en: A bear represented by teeth and a partial jaw
title.zh: 由牙齿和部分下颌代表的熊类

text.en: The account centers on holotype left P4 MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42, paratype right M1 NV-2-40 and partial mandible IPS 46473 from two Spanish localities. These named teeth and jaw define the described anatomical sample.
text.zh: 本页材料包括正模左侧第四前臼齿 MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42、副模右侧第一臼齿 NV-2-40 和部分下颌 IPS 46473，来自西班牙两个地点。这些具名牙齿和下颌构成所描述的形态样本。

title.en: A comparative placement, not a panda ancestor
title.zh: 比较分析的位置，不是大熊猫祖先

text.en: A matrix combining living and fossil bears places Kretzoiarctos within Ailuropodinae. Dental comparisons suggest a more herbivorous tendency, but feeding was not observed. The sample does not identify a direct ancestor of the giant panda or prove identical ecology.
text.zh: 结合现生与化石熊类的矩阵将 Kretzoiarctos 置于熊猫亚科。牙齿比较提示其食性可能更偏植食，但研究没有观察进食。现有样本不能确认它是大熊猫的直系祖先，也不能证明生态完全相同。
